Very nice place for bbq/steaks
Nov 2019 • Friends
Located nearby the market, spacious and cozy place. Sign says Yummy Chicken, but alternative options are available.

Had beef steak and chicken bbq (both came well done, and this was not asked at the time of order). Meat tasted as if it was a bit cooked before getting grilled - yet was juicy anf very tasty!

Didn't go for salads,as service staff recommended not to.

Table cloth is paper, and crayons are placed on every table - you may kill time drawing whilst waiting for your food 😊

Overall, very good experience.
